cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments to cover! I approve the expansion of my influence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. Can you borrow their meeting rooms?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. They may each host my presence instead of sending people to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I authorize a mobile headquarters. Put the department names on the trolley; everyone should see how far my jurisdiction now extends.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 approves expanded responsibility, A3 grants departments the privilege of hosting A and A5 authorizes a branded mobile headquarters, using rank to celebrate shrinking resources as growing reach.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 borrowed rooms cause A3 hosting permission; B4 trolley and desk reassignment cause A5 mobile jurisdiction display.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a workable room solution under budget pressure and B4 offers transport for files, keeping B practical and helpful.

heightening.evidence: B4 loss of a fixed desk causes A5 to celebrate visible reach across all departments through the labeled trolley.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra coverage, B2 no budget and B4 receptionist desk explain the material restrictions; A5 headquarters is A reinterpretation of a trolley.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 departments may host my presence and A5 named trolley make reduced facilities into privileges A grants, earned by B actual solutions.
